content:
- Committed the boundary refactor plus requested .ralph updates as e9ef411 (`Flatten command display boundary`) and pushed it to origin/master.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; it updated current_tasks/current_tasks_done, sent the task email, and printed the same harmless missing .ralph/current_task.txt removal message.
- Repo is now left with post-switch .ralph changes plus unrelated pre-existing dirty files outside this commit. If resuming, start from the new task state and keep unrelated user/.agents changes isolated unless explicitly asked.

- Read previous progress log; it was effectively empty.
- Loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill.
- Observed a dirty worktree in .ralph files and source/test files, so I need to isolate one boundary cleanup carefully and avoid overwriting unrelated edits.

- Selected improve-code-boundaries smell 10 in src/process/worker.rs.
- Verified the drain_process_inbox helper was a fake boundary: only step_once uses it in non-test code.
- make check passed after the temporary proof rename, so next I am inlining the helper into step_once and moving test coverage to step_once behavior.

- Inlined the inbox-draining loop into step_once and removed the wrong helper boundary in src/process/worker.rs.
- Replaced the private-helper unit test with a step_once behavior test that proves only the latest queued request is rejected when busy.
- cargo fmt and make check both pass; next are make lint and make test, then commit/push/task switch.

- make lint passed.
- make test failed during linking before test execution: ld could not find an aarch64 debug object file for the pgtuskmaster binary.
- I am checking whether this was a transient build-artifact race or a reproducible environment issue before deciding how to close out.

- make test passed on retry: 232 tests passed, 16 skipped, with 5 existing leaky tests reported by nextest.
- There was one transient linker failure on the first make test attempt, but it did not reproduce on rerun.
- Next I am reviewing the final diff and then will commit, push, and switch the Ralph task as requested.
